brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: 7 full pieces at level 0: the centre (0,0) plus its six neighbours (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,-1), (0,1), (1,-1), (1,0).
A full top cover on each of the 7 pieces (cover:*;full;top).

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps, 3 on each outer cell. That is every cap socket the configurator offered, and these are the 18 outside edges of a 7-cell flower.

requirements.requirement: Pieces held together, rules and mesh check passed
requirements.evidence: 6 joint bolts join the centre cell to each ring cell, which cleared the LOOSE_BODY warning. check_build shows no issues and meshClash is 'clear'.

finish.summary: Seven-cell flat honeycomb (centre plus 6-cell ring) with 7 top covers, 18 edge caps and 6 joint bolts from the centre cell: 38 parts in all. The checks pass and the meshes clear. The 6 joints between neighbouring ring cells could take optional extra bolts.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
